show: Knowing Me Knowing You with Alan Partridge

eps.d: Talk show host Alan Partridge puts the chat amongst the pigeons in his award-winning six-part spoof series. His guests for the first show of the series include showjumper Sue Lewis, presenter Keith Hunt and punk singer Shona McGough.
Alan Partridge lets the chat out of the bag once again in his own chat show. His 'celebrity' guests are Playboy's agony aunt, a hypnotist, and Hollywood's hottest British acting couple.

Alan Partridge provides humour in a way that only Alan Partridge can, with guests including Northern Europe's sexiest dance act - Hot Pants, American actress Gina Langland, sleazy reporter Lawrence Knowles, and Elsie Morgan, relay star of the 1936 Olympics.
Alan Partridge presents a special French edition of the show live from the Paris Fashion Week of 1994. With co-host Nina Vanier and guests Yvonne Boyd, Philippe Lambert and clowns Cirque des Clownes.
Another edition of the spoof chat show hosted by Alan Partridge, including the new feature 'Partridge Over Britain'. Guests include events promoter Terry Norton.
Alan Partridge interviews child film makers Scott and Dean McLean, lesbians Bridie McMahon and Wanda Harvey and Forbes McAllister.
